# Cupertino

Cupertino is described by its author as a modern design that feels at home on all of your devices, with clean typography, refined spacing and native-inspired components. It needs no plugins and no settings, and is complete the moment it is installed.

![Cupertino screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aaaaalexis/obsidian-cupertino/HEAD/cupertino.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Cupertino"
    author: "Alexis C"
    repo:   "aaaaalexis/obsidian-cupertino"
    slug:   "cupertino"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/cupertino"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/aaaaalexis/obsidian-cupertino"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aaaaalexis/obsidian-cupertino/HEAD/cupertino.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "A modern design that feels right at home. Clean typography, refined spacing, and native-inspired components make Cupertino feel like it belongs on all of your device. No plugins needed, no settings to dig through. It's complete the moment you install it."
}
```
